children: Overview
France digital healthcare solutions provider's H1 2026 revenue grew 7.3%, driven by acquisitions
Net profit for H1 2026 rose 10.5% yr/yr
Profitability improved due to product mix, cost control and accretive acquisitions
Outlook
Equasens aims to strengthen its leadership in digital healthcare solutions in France and Europe
Company plans to expand AI integration and SaaS/cloud offerings to enhance its product portfolio
Equasens expects to benefit from Wave 2 of the Ségur digital health programme through H1 2027
Result Drivers
ACQUISITIONS - Revenue growth was mainly driven by the Erevo acquisition and integration of Novaprove and DIS businesses
PRODUCT MIX & COST CONTROL - Improved profitability was attributed to a favourable product mix and tight control over expenses, particularly personnel costs
SÉGUR PROGRAMME - Initial impact from Wave 2 of France's Ségur digital healthcare investment programme supported revenue
